website_summary.name: MathGen Calculator
website_summary.description: MathGen Calculator is a sleek, user-friendly online tool designed for performing basic arithmetic calculations with a clean mint cream background and teal-accented components.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist design with a mint cream background and teal highlights for interactive elements. At the top, there's a header labeled "MathGen" accompanied by a calculator icon. Below the header, users can choose the calculation type, currently set to "Basic Arithmetic." A central area allows users to enter mathematical expressions, with buttons for numbers, operators, and functions arranged neatly below. There are also buttons for clearing the input and deleting characters. At the bottom, a section displays the calculation history, which is currently empty.
website_summary.functionality: The website enables users to perform basic arithmetic operations. It includes a numeric keypad with digits 0-9, decimal point, and operators such as addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (×), and division (÷). Users can input expressions into the designated field and execute calculations. Additionally, there are options to clear the current input, delete individual characters, and access a dropdown menu for selecting different operators. The calculation history section keeps track of past calculations for reference.

functionality_testing.name: Clear Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Clear button resets the input field.
functionality_testing.preconditions: An expression has been entered into the input field.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The input field should be empty after clicking the "Clear" button.
procedure: Enter an expression into the input field.
Click on the Clear button.
Verify that the input field is empty.

functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the "3" button correctly inputs the digit "3" into the expression.
functionality_testing.preconditions: An expression has been partially entered into the input field.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The digit "3" should be correctly appended to the input field. 7. Next Steps : Click the "3" button to complete the expression "12 + 3".
procedure: Enter part of an expression into the input field.
Click on the Digit 3 button.
Verify that the digit "3" appears in the input field.

functionality_testing.name: Equals Button Test
